info.title: MedConnect Pro API
info.description: Generated OpenAPI contract for the MedConnect Pro demonstration API. This is not a HIPAA-certified production system. Examples and fixtures must be synthetic demo data only. Do not put secrets, tokens, or real patient information in this document.

bearer.description: Opaque mock access token (Authorization: Bearer). Stand-in for a future OAuth 2.0 access token, not a production IdP credential. Platform health and readiness do not require a token. Never commit tokens.

providerId.description: User id of the assigned provider in this practice.

practiceId.description: Server-resolved practice id. Clients must not send this field for authorization.

synthetic.description: Always true. This API stores synthetic demo data only.
